title: A worker agent's git still shares the operator's rerere cache; its pinned environment does not disable it
body: tick 6na disabled rerere on every git the reconciler runs, but an agent's own git (a pull, a merge, a rebase inside its worktree of the same repository) shares the same .git/rr-cache and inherits the host's global rerere.enabled=true, so an operator's hand-recorded resolution can be replayed into a worker's tree without the worker choosing it. gitbin.WithNoAutoMaintenance already pins agent environments through GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/GIT_CONFIG_KEY_n/GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_n, so the rerere pairs could ride the same mechanism in one place.
